ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) base with approximately 15% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters resulting in a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-intensity field across both lobes. High-intensity circular geometric blobs (rosettes) distributed across the central and proximal areas. High-intensity banding visible along the distal trailing edges and lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical cleft dividing the two lobes; interior angle approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations. Distinct high-amplitude peaks (jagged protrusions) are localized on the far right lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep on the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly swept-back tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white rings and spots (diameter 5-15 pixels) distributed across both ventral lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible, including one prominent diagonal rake mark on the lower-left lobe and multiple shorter horizontal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the entire surface consistent with barnacle colonization; significant irregular erosion/trauma on the terminal edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white spotting pattern concentrated near the median notch area against the dark primary pigmentation.
